## Trigger

When I work with Claude Code and a tracker, I want mods that show my work items, tasks and sessions, so I can follow the work without reading raw tracker writes.

## Success Criteria

- The marketplace installs each released mod with one /plugin install line.
- Every mod passes claude plugin validate, claude plugin test and tsc.

Design: docs/design.md.

- No mod needs basicly.

payload.description:
## Trigger

When Claude writes a tracker file or runs a tracker CLI, I want one short row with verb, id, cut title, state and priority, so I can read the transcript without JSON noise.

## Success Criteria

- Write, Edit and Bash tracker rows are replaced on screen only.
- An unparsed row falls back to the engine row.

Design: docs/design.md.
payload.requirements: - The title length is a userConfig field.
payload.title: quiet-items: one short row in place of raw tracker writes

payload.description:
## Trigger

When Claude plans tasks, I want to see them, add and remove them before, during and after a session, so I can steer the plan.

## Success Criteria

- /task-pane toggles the pane; userConfig mode off, toggle or always.
- Tasks added outside a session enter the next session.

Design: docs/design.md.

payload.title: task-pane: Claude's task list in a toggleable pane with add and remove

payload.description:
## Trigger

When several Claude sessions run, I want to see each one's task, worktree, time worked and an estimate, so I can decide where to look.

## Success Criteria

- Rows come from claude agents --json, polled only while the pane is visible.
- The estimate is labelled est. and is absent without a task list.

Design: docs/design.md.
